frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The observed ETF premium pi = p - n mixes three things: lagged price discovery from stale NAV, NAV pricing noise, and transitory liquidity. The Madhavan-Sobczyk state-space model splits price into fundamental v plus a mean-reverting shock u, and a Kalman filter recovers the unobserved true premium u from prices and NAVs.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Premium Decomposition: Price Discovery vs Transitory Liquidity
